important_note: Liraglutide is NOT available as an oral tablet or capsule in the United States. It is exclusively available as a subcutaneous injection in prefilled pen devices. Therefore, traditional pill physical characteristics (imprints, shape, color, size in mm) do not apply. The variants listed represent the available injectable formulations.
